name: Escúzar (Spain)
description: Green field with a white triangle from the hoist to the middle of the fly, charged with the arms of Escúzar beneath a marquess's crown (a castle and a chalice).
history: Escúzar adopted its arms officially on 16 December 2011 and its flag on 22 October 2013; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a green cloth with a white triangle whose base is the hoist and whose apex is at the centre of the fly, with the arms.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly
Escúzar arms — castle and chalice beneath a marquess's crown
